entries.note: The rEngine adaptation excludes .cache because generated build/runtime/version trees add lookup cost and contain capabilities or captured sessions that are not source knowledge. The original installed tool is unchanged; provenance pins the copied implementation and its cache-exclusion regression. Also exclude pinned third_party source: owned-code rationale queries should not rebuild a large index for upstream graphics headers. Inspect those explicitly with rg. Separate per-session caches avoid concurrent SQLite writers.
